query: 2020, textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE p.year = 2020
  AND (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
      plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%textattack%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

sql:

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,

     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%translational%innovation%in%medicine%and%complexity%' THEN 2
     ELSE 0
   END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: rtm at semeval 2016 task 1 predicting semantic similarity with referential translation machines and related statistics, semeval, 2016, koc university
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2016
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%rtm%' AND p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' AND p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%')
    OR p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machines%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machines%'
  )
  AND (
    p.venue ILIKE '%semeval%' OR p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%semeval%'
  )
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%koç university%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machines%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%koç university%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

- institution_id (VARCHAR, FOREIGN KEY → Institutions.institution_id): Reference to institution
- PRIMARY KEY: (author_id, institution_id)

RELATIONSHIPS:
- Papers ←→ Authors (many-to-many through PaperAuthors)
- Authors ←→ Institutions (many-to-many through AuthorInstitutions)
- To get papers with authors: JOIN Papers with PaperAuthors with Authors
- To get author affiliations: JOIN Authors with AuthorInstitutions with Institutions
- To filter by institution: JOIN through PaperAuthors, AuthorInstitutions, and Institutions

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Use canonical_venue to query across workshops (e.g., canonical_venue='ACL' includes BioNLP@ACL)
- Use venue_type to filter main vs workshop papers
- Only 35.9% of papers have affiliation data (coverage limitation)
- Full text NOT in database - query source JSONL by corpus_id if needed

INDEXES:
- Papers: year, month, canonical_venue, venue_type, citation_count
- Authors: name
- Institutions: country_code, institution_type
